$comment: Machine-readable map of this repository and of notes/. Human equivalent: notes/README.md. Keep the two in step — a reader that trusts this file will not open the other one.

project.name: Myunivokai
project.meaning: My Unique OK AI. NOT 'my universe' — the universe family is one of several and the branding must not privilege it.
project.mission: Turn a person's answers into a living 3D world that is exactly, only, theirs.

knowledgeBase.principle: Knowledge describes, plans prescribe, memory records. Which folder a document is in decides who is wrong when it disagrees with the code.

rules.question: What am I not allowed to get wrong?
rules.authority: gate — a change can fail on it

knowledge.question: How does this actually work?
knowledge.readWhen: before changing something you did not write
knowledge.authority: descriptive — if it disagrees with the code, the document is wrong

plans.question: What am I supposed to build?
plans.authority: prescriptive — if it disagrees with the code, the code changes
plans.warning: Several plans carry a corrections section that contradicts their own earlier sections. Read it first.

memory.question: What happened last time, and where was the plan wrong?

evolution.question: Why did the direction change?
evolution.authority: research — nothing in it is approved or built

skills.question: How do I perform this procedure?
skills.authority: runbook — every stage has a verification

agents.question: Which of all this applies to my task?
agents.readWhen: first, to avoid reading the rest

requiredReading.$comment: Ordered. Everything else is selected through notes/agents/.

apps.name: myunivokai-web
apps.stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, React Three Fiber

services.name: api-gateway
services.role: the one origin the web app talks to

services.name: dna-service
services.role: turns answers into the semantic personality profile

services.name: analytics-service
services.role: CQRS read model fed by NATS events

services.name: telemetry-service
services.role: the one service not written in Go

contracts.$comment: The only surface the client shares with the backend. If a frontend document would change a backend decision, this is underspecified.

worldFamilies.$comment: The `family` key every backend service stamps into its configs. Adding one is NOT only a code change — see the two manual steps below.
addingAFamilyAlsoRequires: a Postgres migration widening the family CHECK constraint
widening the dna-family-results-v1 JetStream consumer subject filter — this one fails silently

performance.policy: quality first; never lowered for weaker hardware
performance.neverMeasureWith: swiftshader, which the e2e suite pins deliberately for comparability and which is roughly 10x slower
performance.knownStall: a cold scene mount blocks the main thread for up to ~2.7s compiling shaders; compileAsync was tried and does nothing on this project's driver

constraints.assets: A 3D model needs isDownloadable and a CC licence before it can ship. A licence stated on a collection page is not a licence on an asset.
constraints.ai: Never called from the client, and produces the semantic profile only — never geometry.
constraints.integrations: One interface per vendor: ai.Provider, wake.Platform, TelemetrySink. Business services depend on the interface.
